SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name, p.main_image, p.category_id, p.status, p.spec_mode, s.min_price, s.max_price, s.total_stock, s.enabled_sku_count, CASE WHEN p.spec_mode = 'SINGLE' THEN s.default_sku_id ELSE NULL END AS default_sku_id FROM product p JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price, SUM(stock) AS total_stock, COUNT(*) AS enabled_sku_count, MAX(CASE WHEN spec_key = 'DEFAULT' THEN id ELSE NULL END) AS default_sku_id FROM product_sku WHERE status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY product_id ) s ON s.product_id = p.id
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND p.category_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_category WHERE id = #{categoryId} OR parent_id = #{categoryId})
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.min_price ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY s.min_price DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.sales DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
